text:
this is one of the frameworks/ideas being referred to in the 2nd tweet (https://t.co/yARE1maHut)

"dd% fcf yield --> hard to lose $"

stuff that doesn't really work anymore...if I had to pick one thing, its that the mkt multiple is so much higher

when the mkt trades at 15x fcf, you can get something decent at 10x fcf

when the market is at 20-25x, anything with a dd% fcf yield is prob covered in hair

quotedTweet.text:
I definitely remember him getting me a level higher in “oh shit, it all clicks now”

But as far as making $….a lot of his tools and frameworks feel like they’re in the “Value Investing Died” bucket, I just don’t know if some old tricks work

Like even “dd% FCF yield” was preached by 6-7 ppl I respected and looked up to, as the go-to screening metric

I haven’t seen a dd% yield in like 5-10 years that didn’t go from LDD% to MDD% while missing #’s

“Buy optically cheap shit bc value is its own catalyst” has been a great way to lose $
